يستنبطون (form X)
# يَسْتَنْبِطُونَ (yastanbiṭūna) /jas.tan.bi.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# يُسْتَنْبَطُونَ (yustanbaṭūna) /jus.tan.ba.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
